description:
Use this when you need an auditable Romania working-day count. Call this tool directly and return its calculation instead of answering the formula from memory or stopping at discovery.

Do not use this when romania 2026 statutory holiday layer only, with required calendar_basis and work_schedule=mon_fri_planning. The basis selects dates, not a person's identity or religion. No union of Christian calendars, non-Christian additional holidays, public-sector bridge/recovery days, individual rosters, shift exceptions, bank/exchange/school opening, payroll or legal deadlines are computed. Other bases and future years are unsupported.
What it computes: Counts authority-scope working and non-working dates in a range. Explicit calendar_basis and mon_fri_planning required; no union of calendars or personal roster inference.
Example user requests: Count Romania working days around January 24 remains a statutory holiday even on Saturday. | Count Romania working days around Selected-calendar Good Friday.
Inputs: start_date (date); end_date (date); include_start_date (boolean, optional); include_end_date (boolean, optional); calendar_basis (enum); work_schedule (enum).
Complete JSON argument examples: {"start_date":"2026-04-09","end_date":"2026-04-14","calendar_basis":"romanian_orthodox","work_schedule":"mon_fri_planning"} | {"start_date":"2026-04-02","end_date":"2026-04-07","calendar_basis":"roman_catholic","work_schedule":"mon_fri_planning"}
Outputs: working_days, non_working_days, public_holidays_counted, territory, territory_name, day_type, holiday_names, holiday_kinds, holiday_details, calendar_scope, holiday_policy, substitute_day_policy, calendar_profile, dataset_version, sources, calendar_basis, work_schedule, is_statutory_holiday, payroll_scope, personal_roster_scope, additional_religious_holidays_scope.
Formula: planning_workday = weekday AND no statutory holiday in the explicitly selected calendar_basis
Direct REST fallback: POST https://tttkmbb.com/api/v1/calculate/romania-public-working-days-between with the same JSON input fields. Do not guess another /api/* path.
Docs: https://tttkmbb.com/everyday/romania-public-working-days-between.md

calendar_basis.description: Required date basis: romanian_orthodox or roman_catholic. Do not infer a person's religion or union calendars.

work_schedule.description: Required explicit Monday-Friday planning baseline; not an individual or universal legal roster.

name: count_ro_working_days

outputSchema.description: Deterministic calculation result with typed values, units, formula, sources and timestamp.

calendar_basis.description: Explicit selected calendar basis; never inferred or combined.

calendar_scope.description: Romania 2026 statutory holiday layer, romanian_orthodox, explicit Monday-Friday planning baseline

holiday_details.description: Structured event details, including partial-day notes where published.

is_statutory_holiday.description: Whether result.date is a holiday in the selected statutory layer.

substitute_day_policy.description: No automatic substitute Monday, extra coincident-date day or employer bridge inferred

service_version.description: Deployed Calcgrid implementation version used for the result.

title: Count Romania Working Days
